about: Made-up family notes about a relative who may wander, each with the kind the family app should sort it into. Written before any model run. Kinds, as the app's prompt defines them: place (somewhere they like to go), address (a place they used to live), wandering (where they were found before), clothing (what they wear). No real person, place or health detail.
